name: web-terminal-hub
description: Web-based terminal hub with multi-tab support via ttyd + Cloudflare Tunnel

scripts.cleanserver: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9091 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Killed PID ' + $_) }"
